Subject: High tail latency and 500s impacting checkout recommendations

Jonas —

We saw a spike starting ~08:05 PDT: 99th percentile tail latency on /v1/generate for our recommendation model rose from ~280ms to ~2.1s, and a correlated increase in 500 responses to ~4.3% for a ~45 minute window. Subject: RCA draft: transient autoscaler interaction + cache eviction pattern

Team — initial findings (draft):

Summary of impact:
- Window: 08:05–08:50 PDT, elevated 99p latency (peak ~2.1s) and 500s peaking at 4.3% for atlasware-us-1 region.
- Surface area: /v1/generate (inference), ~12% of Atlasware traffic routed to dedicated pool; remainder on hosted.

Preliminary root cause hypothesis:
1) A burst of long-sequence requests from a client experiment produced sustained GPU scheduling pressure and increased KV cache churn.
2) The autoscaler reacted to per-instance CPU jitter by briefly terminating one worker in the dedicated pool; during termination we observed degraded scheduling density and sub-optimal kernel selection (fallback path for quantized ops).
3) Simultaneous prefix-KV cache evictions caused repeated cold-KV lookups for hot prefixes, amplifying latency.

Corroborating evidence attached: service traces, kernel selection logs, and the PS histogram.

Immediate mitigations enacted (08:18–08:40):
- Increased min replicas in the dedicated pool for Atlasware by +2 to absorb traffic (automated policy updated).
- Disabled aggressive eviction policy temporarily for the affected pool.
- Enabled a targeted fallback to a smaller-sequence model variant for new sessions above 512 tokens to reduce per-token scheduling overhead.

Open action items (short list):
- A1: engineering to backfill missing GPU scheduling metrics in our observability (Evelyn) — target 2026-08-13 EOD.
- A2: runtime to harden autoscaler termination smoothing (Marissa) — target 2026-08-21.
- A3: product + solutions to coordinate an Atlasware traffic steering plan for canarying model-variant fallback (Jonas + Laura) — target 2026-08-18.

Requesting review: please comment on the RCA draft below and approve the readout content. I will produce a polished RFC+deck for the exec readout.

Attachments: rca-draft-1.pdf, ps-histogram-20260811.png

-Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
